verdict.rationale: Steel's CLI and Sessions API support running sequential browser steps (navigate, click, extract, stop) via terminal or SDK, but nothing in the evidence describes composing workflows with loops, conditionals, or parameterized reusable flows — that logic is left to whichever orchestrating agent framework (CrewAI, AgentKit, etc.) sits on top of Steel. Missing for 10: any documentation of control-flow constructs (loops/branches), workflow parameters, or a workflow builder/editor within Steel itself.
